title: Notion
description: Agent tools for Notion: search pages and databases, read page content, create and update pages, query databases and append content. Uses a Notion internal integration token stored in the add-on config.

permissions.reason: Call the Notion REST API with the configured integration token

fields.label: Notion integration token
fields.help: Internal integration secret from https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations (starts with ntn_). Create an integration, then share the target pages or databases with it in Notion (page menu → Connections). Stored in the host vault. Until it is set every tool returns account_failed.

descriptor.name: notion
descriptor.title: Notion tools
descriptor.description: Search, read, create and update Notion pages and databases as a Notion integration. Content is written and returned as markdown; the add-on converts it to and from Notion blocks.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search pages and databases shared with the integration. Returns id, type, title and url for each result; use the ids with the other tools. Query matches page titles and content; an empty query lists everything shared.

query.description: Text to search for; empty lists all shared pages and databases

objectType.description: Restrict results to pages or databases

startCursor.description: Cursor from a previous search result

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read page metadata: title, url, icon, parent and all properties with their values as plain text. Page body is not included; use get_page_content for it.

pageId.description: Notion page id (with or without dashes)

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Read a page body as markdown: headings, paragraphs, lists, to-dos, quotes, code and dividers. Nested blocks are indented. Good for summarizing or editing pages.

maxDepth.description: How deep to render nested blocks, 1 to 5, default 3

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a page inside a database or under another page. For a database parent set parentType to database_id and pass title (the add-on resolves the database title column) plus optional properties {"Property name": value} with plain strings, numbers, booleans or a select name; for a page parent set parentType to page_id and pass title. content is markdown converted to blocks under the new page. Returns the new page id and url.

properties.description: Extra database properties as simple values: string, number, boolean or select name; for anything richer pass Notion property objects with $raw suffix handled as raw values

rawProperties.description: Advanced: a raw Notion properties object passed as-is, merged over the convenience ones

content.description: Markdown body for the new page

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Update an existing page: change the title (the add-on resolves the title column), set database properties with simple values, change the icon, or archive (trash) and restore the page. Page body is not changed by this tool; use append_blocks to add content.

properties.description: Database properties as simple values: string, number, boolean or select name

rawProperties.description: Advanced: a raw Notion properties object passed as-is, merged over the convenience ones

archived.description: true moves the page to trash, false restores it

tools.name: append_blocks
tools.description: Append markdown content to the end of a page body: headings, paragraphs, lists, to-dos, quotes, code and dividers. Existing content is kept.

tools.name: update_block
tools.description: Rewrite the text of an existing block: paragraphs, headings, list items, to-dos, quotes, code and callouts. content is plain text for that one block; markdown is not parsed here, so use append_blocks to add new markdown content. For a to-do block pass checked to tick or untick it, for a code block pass language to change the syntax. The block type is read from the id, so blocks that cannot hold text (images, dividers, child pages) are refused with the reason.

blockId.description: Notion block id (with or without dashes)

content.description: New block text as plain text; omit to keep the text as it is

checked.description: to-do blocks only: true ticks the item, false unticks it

language.description: code blocks only: language name, e.g. ts or python

tools.name: delete_block
tools.description: Delete one block together with its children (the block moves to the Notion trash and can be restored there). To change content prefer update_block, to add content prefer append_blocks.

blockId.description: Notion block id (with or without dashes)

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query a database and get matching rows with their properties as plain text and a page-content preview. filter is a raw Notion filter object (e.g. {"property": "Status", "select": {"equals": "Done"}}) and sorts a raw Notion sorts array; ids and urls are returned for follow-up get_page calls.

startCursor.description: Cursor from a previous query result

tools.name: get_database
tools.description: Read database schema: title, url, description and every property with its name, type and, for selects and multi-selects, the option names. Call it before query_database or create_page to see what a database accepts.
